note: Numbers measured on the current pool. Anything derived from the detector or from OCR is an ESTIMATE, not reviewed ground truth. Only the LogoDet columns in domain_mismatch.json are human GT.

data_questions.4_videos_with_no_logos: UNDECIDABLE by model: the detector fires on 100% of frames in both videos at conf>=0.10 with median conf 0.14-0.15, so it carries no information about which frames are logo-free. Requires the review sheet.

5_known_brands_present.basis: real OCR on 51 sampled frames, matched against the 39-brand catalog
5_known_brands_present.note: META only in 63fb2ac4d1; SAMSUNG/GOOGLE/NVIDIA in df01d5a843

6_unknown_unseen_brands_present.basis: OCR strings with no catalog match; real brands, not in the 39-brand catalog

efficiency.verdict: OCR is the bottleneck by ~68x over the detector (1145 ms vs 16.9 ms per frame). Batching the detector buys nothing; the OCR worker is the cost centre.

label_audit_logodet.verdict: 8% of LogoDet boxes cover more than half the frame. A full-frame box is not a logo; training on these teaches the model to fire on scenes. This is label corruption, not a domain preference, and it is a candidate cause of the large-bucket recall of 0.0000.
